newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Patient not needled by Dutch doctor's memory lapse.
newsitem.headline: Patient not needled by Dutch doctor's memory lapse.

text.p: An acupuncture patient had to be freed by police after his doctor was called away to an emergency, leaving him bristling with needles, and then forgot him and went home.
"The man had been lying there for more than an hour before he realised everyone had gone home," a police spokesman said.
The 49-year old patient was "very good about it" and made a new appointment for further treatment, the spokesman said.
